## `katx`

```
$ katx --help
options:
  --build-args|-b      add additional arguments to docker build.
  --help               prints this message.
  --host|-h            sets current hostname. Remembers setting.
  --user|-u            set the user option to use with docker exec. Defaults to ''. Remembers setting.

positional commands:
  build                runs docker build.
  connect              runs docker exec to start a shell in the project's container.
  debug                Placeholder for custom docker run command intended for debugging.
  down                 `docker compose down`.
  jlab                 lists the address (including token) of the currently running jupyter server.
  private              Unpublish: stop serving on the public entrypoint and recreate the container.
  ps                   Lists containers associated with this project.
  pub                  Publish: serve this project on the public entrypoint (:8081) + dashboard. Remembers setting.
  render               Run 'quarto render' to create static site files.
  restart|rebuild      Shortcut for: katx down, katx build, katx up.
  rm                   `docker rm ...`.
  rmf                  `docker rm -f ...`.
  run                  Shortcut for: katx build, katx up, katx render, katx status.
  status               supervisorctl status.
  stop                 manual docker stop command. Generally better to use 'down'
  update_context       Sync shared context files from ~/.katapult/template/ (removes stale, copies fresh).
  up                   `docker compose up -d`.
```

### `katx pub` / `katx private`

`katx pub` publishes a project to the **public-apps dashboard**; `katx private`
unpublishes it. See [Public apps](public-access.qmd) for the full model.

`pub` layers `build/docker-compose.pub.yml` onto the base compose file, adding a
second Traefik router on the hidden `public` entrypoint (`:8081`) plus
`katapult.pub.*` metadata that the dashboard reads. The choice is remembered via
`PUBLIC=true|false` in `.katapult/HOSTVARS` (host-local, not committed), so
`up`/`restart`/`rebuild` keep serving it publicly until you run `katx private`.

### `katx update_context`

`katx update_context` refreshes project files that are managed by the user's Katapult template overrides.

The command reads **`.katapult/.context_manifest`**, removes those previously managed files if they still exist, copies the current files from **`~/.katapult/template/`**, and writes a new manifest. This makes file renames safe: old managed names are removed and new names are added.

Files not listed in the manifest are not removed, so project-specific Cursor rules and other local files are preserved.
